title: Total variation of a smooth function on a bounded open set by duality with test fields (parent step 5)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ Euclid P open and bounded, w : Euclid P → ℝ of class C^∞ and V ∈ ℝ. Assume ∫ Dw(y)(g(y)) dy ≤ V for every C^∞ map g : Euclid P → Euclid P with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ W and |g(y)| ≤ 1 for all y. Then ∫_W ‖Dw(y)‖ dy ≤ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (w : Euclid P → ℝ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : ℝ), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) w → (∀ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ W → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ w y (g y) ≤ V) → ∫ y in W, ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ V
